26225.rationale: Conditional on a move, Arsenal are clear frontrunners: Romano (Jun 18) says the player is 'fully on board' and Arsenal 'will go all in'; Schira reports agreement in principle on a contract to 2031. Chelsea, Man City and Man Utd are also interested. Villa want about GBP100m; Sky says around GBP80m could tempt them.
26225.next_info: Club-to-club talks expected after England's World Cup exit (R32 ~Jun 28-Jul 3; final Jul 19). Watch for an Arsenal bid, a 'here we go', or a late Chelsea/City hijack.

617889.rationale: Vozinha (40) is a free agent after Chaves and became a World Cup sensation. Jorge Nicola (R7, Jun 24) reports 3 Brazilian Serie B clubs from the upper half of the table are negotiating, the keenest from the Northeast. Athletic-MG is the only named suitor; Ceara declined. CRB have the best attack in Serie B. Liga MX was also mentioned, and Chaves' owner also owns Atletico La Paz.
617889.next_info: Decision likely after Cape Verde's World Cup run (3rd group game ~Jun 26; R32 early July). Watch Brazilian media (ge.globo, Nicola) for the club name; Serie B window July.

696503.rationale: Liverpool bid EUR100m (90+10), which was rejected Jun 18; an improved bid of about EUR115-120m is expected. Personal terms are reportedly agreed (Media Foot; Plettenberg says 'no issue'). PSG have stepped back over the price. Leipzig want EUR120-130m+ or a renewal.
696503.next_info: Improved Liverpool bid expected late June/July; Ivory Coast World Cup run. If Leipzig renew him with a release clause there is no move (question likely void).

108618.rationale: Newcastle finished 12th with no Europe and Bruno looked unhappy; CEO says 1-2 stars may be sold. Man Utd held 'formative talks' (Ben Jacobs) but age is an obstacle and they signed Ederson. Man City and Arsenal are generically linked. No concrete bid found, so mass is spread.
108618.next_info: Brazil's World Cup run (into July). Watch for concrete bids late July/August, and for a Tonali sale (Spurs GBP75m bid rejected) that may affect whether Bruno is sold.

810891.rationale: Free agent; decision after the World Cup. Fenerbahce's new president Aziz Yildirim offered about $35m/yr for 3 years; the ex-board member says a deal was close. The Saudi league is the money favourite (Al-Ittihad and Al-Hilal leading the chase per Gazzetta), with mixed reports on Ittihad. MLS (San Diego, Chicago) is interested; Romano says there are no Inter Miami talks and no agreement with anyone.
810891.next_info: After Egypt's World Cup exit (group ends ~Jun 26-27; R32 early July). Saudi window July-Sept; Fenerbahce CL qualifiers from late July.

243962.rationale: Forecast conditional on a move; a move itself looks unlikely (renewal offer on table, talks paused, contract to 2027). Romano (Jun 12): Real Madrid not expected to advance after agreeing Bernardo Silva on a free. Rodri is Madrid-born and reportedly keen on Madrid, which remains the likeliest destination if he leaves.
243962.next_info: After Spain's World Cup campaign (final Jul 19), City renewal talks resume. Any Madrid U-turn or a City decision to cash in would be reported July-August.

72574.rationale: Fiorentina (sporting director Paratici, ex-Spurs) will not trigger the EUR10m option but may return with a discounted fee or a loan-with-option (tuttomercatoweb, Jun 24). There are no other concrete suitors. De Zerbi, his former coach, is now at Spurs and the agent says he would like Solomon to stay.
72574.next_info: Fiorentina decision/negotiation with Spurs late June-July; Spurs pre-season under De Zerbi (July).

918938.rationale: Barca plan to offer a renewal and Ferran wants to stay; his contract runs to 2027 and he will not run it down. Atletico wanted him and he was floated in a Julian Alvarez swap. PSG listed him as a target if Barcola leaves (Sky/Bendoni). A move looks unlikely, so this forecast is conditional on one happening.
918938.next_info: Barca-Atletico Alvarez talks; Barcola-Liverpool developments; renewal talks after Spain's World Cup (July).

459381.rationale: Juventus sporting director Ottolini (knew him at Genoa) is driving 'quiet moves' (Gazzetta), and Spence would replace Cambiaso if Cambiaso is sold to Barca or Chelsea. Spurs value him at EUR40-45m with a contract to 2029; he could also move on loan, which would not count. Andy Robertson's arrival at Spurs blocks his path.
459381.next_info: Decision after England's World Cup. Watch for a Cambiaso sale; Juve need to sell before buying.

160265.rationale: Watkins (30, contract to 2028, 21 goals) is Villa's first-choice striker and a move is unlikely. The only concrete lead is Ertan Suzgun via Transfermarkt TR (Jun 24): Fenerbahce are working on him, with contacts over terms ongoing under the big-spending new president Yildirim. Watkins nearly joined Arsenal in 2025.
160265.next_info: Turkish media on Fenerbahce bids (July); Villa PSR sales (a Rogers sale would reduce pressure); England World Cup exit.

770763.rationale: No concrete summer-2026 transfer reports found for Konsa (28, contract to 2028, Villa vice-captain, England starter). Forecast is spread over plausible PL suitors; he is a boyhood Spurs fan.
770763.next_info: Post-World Cup (July-August) rumours; Villa's PSR-driven sales.

225772.rationale: Tottenham are advancing on a deal of about GBP60m (Daily Mail, Jun 8; Romano says 'progress'). The player wants the move, and on Jun 21 the move was described as effectively formalised with only add-ons remaining (Sky via TTLAB).

248237.rationale: Man Utd (Carrick) are the long-term suitor; the verbal agreement on personal terms from 2025 'remains valid' (Romano) and a GBP50m opening bid was mooted. However, United signed Ederson and reportedly prioritise Mateus Fernandes, Scott, Tchouameni and Wharton, while Brighton may lower their price.
248237.next_info: Man Utd midfield decision July; Brighton sales (Van Hecke to Spurs).
